Welcome to our website!

Hilltop Kennels has been caring for dogs since 1998. We are a family run boarding kennels on the edge of the Peak District.

Our kennels are heated in winter and every dog gets two walks a day in our five acre field. We also offer grooming and day care. Please ring us to check availability, especially over Christmas and the summer holidays which book up early.

Prices start from £22 per night for one dog.
